mapper.select: SELECT category_id, ROUND(SUM(amount) / #{monthsBack}) AS avg_amount FROM `transaction` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND txn_type = 0 AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND txn_date >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{referenceYearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL #{monthsBack} MONTH) AND txn_date < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{referenceYearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY category_id
